what: a lump of rock with garnet crystals growing in it, as a miner breaks it out of the mountain: one fist-sized lump of rough pale grey stone with flat broken faces, and half sunk in its top three big round deep red crystals, each crystal a ball made of many small flat faces like a cut gem that grew by itself, each as wide as a third of the lump, glossy, with a white glint on each.
colours: Rough pale grey stone with darker grey cracks; three deep blood-red crystals, bright red where the light falls, nearly black in their shadows, white glints.
pose: Seen from the front and a little from above, the lump sitting level as if hung in the air, the three crystals on its top.
must_show: one lump of pale grey rock
three round deep red crystals sunk in its top
small flat faces on each crystal

what: one rough lump of raw amber picked up on a cold northern beach: a smooth rounded lump of clear honey-coloured amber, wider than it is tall, shaped like a big drop of honey that has set hard, polished on one side and dull and frosted on the other; light shines through it so it glows warmly from inside, and deep inside it, near the middle, sits one tiny dark winged gnat, trapped there for ever.
colours: Warm honey orange and deep golden amber, darker brown where it is thickest, yellow light inside it, a pale frosted patch, white glints, one tiny dark brown gnat inside.
pose: Seen from the front and a little to one side, lying level as if hung in the air.
must_show: one rounded lump of clear orange amber
glows warmly where light passes through

what: one rough chunk of lapis lazuli as it comes out of the old mountain mines: a heavy broken lump of stone with flat, slanting broken faces, none of them square, the stone a deep rich ultramarine blue all through, flecked with many tiny bright gold specks like stars and crossed by two thin white streaks. One face is polished smooth and glossy and shows the blue at its deepest.
colours: Deep rich ultramarine blue stone, darker navy in the shadows, many tiny bright gold specks, two thin white streaks, white glints on the polished face.
pose: Seen from the front and a little from above, sitting level as if hung in the air.
must_show: one rough lump of deep blue stone
tiny gold specks in the blue
broken flat faces

what: one loose cut ruby, drawn big and bold: an oval gemstone cut with a broad flat oval table on top and rows of flat slanting faces round it, coming to a point underneath, so that from a little to the side it is a wide gleaming oval; a pure, bright, glowing red, the red of red sealing wax, lit from inside, with sharp white glints on its faces.
colours: Pure bright red, deeper red in the lower faces, sharp white glints on the flat faces, pale pink light where it is brightest.
pose: Seen from the front and a little from above, the flat top tilted toward the viewer, lying level as if hung in the air.
must_show: one oval cut red gemstone
flat faces with white glints
a flat oval top

what: one loose cut sapphire, drawn big and bold: a cushion-shaped gemstone, a square with rounded corners and bulging sides, cut with a broad flat table on top and rows of flat slanting faces round it; a soft velvety cornflower blue, the blue of a summer sky at noon, glowing gently from inside, with sharp white glints on its faces.
colours: Soft velvety cornflower blue, deeper royal blue in the lower faces, sharp white glints, pale sky-blue where it is brightest.
pose: Seen from the front and a little from above, the flat top tilted toward the viewer, lying level as if hung in the air.
must_show: one cushion-shaped cut blue gemstone
flat faces with white glints
a flat square top with rounded corners

what: one great loose diamond cut in the old Indian way, drawn big and bold: a large stone shaped like a pear or a teardrop lying on its side, the round end at the left and the point at the right, cut with a broad flat table on top and many flat faces round it; perfectly clear and colourless, icy white, its faces flashing pale grey, pale sky-blue and white, as clear as the purest water.
colours: Clear icy white, faces of pale grey and pale sky-blue, sharp white glints, charcoal edges between the faces.
pose: Seen from the front and a little from above, the flat top tilted toward the viewer, lying level as if hung in the air.
must_show: one large clear colourless cut gemstone shaped like a teardrop
many flat faces with white glints

what: the eye of a temple idol, prised out of a great statue: one huge smooth domed green gemstone as big as a hen's egg, polished round like an egg cut in half lengthways, a deep glowing emerald green, still sitting in its frame of thick yellow gold shaped like a carved almond-shaped eyelid with a heavy brow ridge along its top; at the edges of the gold frame three short broken gold prongs stick out where it was levered out of the stone face.
colours: Deep glowing emerald-green stone with a pale green shine and a white glint; heavy yellow gold frame, brown-gold in the shadows.
pose: Seen from the front, the almond-shaped frame lying level, the green stone facing the viewer, as if hung in the air.
must_show: one huge smooth domed green gem
thick gold almond-shaped eyelid frame round it
broken gold prongs at the edge

what: a heavy Viking arm-ring of silver, the kind of ring a chieftain gave his warriors and a trader weighed on his scales as money: three thick silver rods twisted together like a rope, each rod as thick as a finger, bent into a wide open ring shaped like the letter C, the gap at the bottom; the two ends of the rope are hammered flat into small blunt plates stamped with a row of dots. One end has a fresh bright cut where a piece was chopped off to pay for something.
colours: Bright silver, pale grey with white glints, charcoal in the grooves of the twist; one bright fresh cut at one end.
pose: Seen from the front, the open ring standing upright like the letter C, the gap at the bottom, the inside of the ring empty backdrop.
must_show: one thick open ring of twisted silver rods
C shape with a gap
flat ends

what: a round Anglo-Saxon brooch of gold as big as a palm: one flat round disc of yellow gold, its whole face covered in a pattern of many small flat red garnet panels laid side by side like the cells of a honeycomb, each panel bordered by a thin raised gold wall, the panels arranged in two rings round the middle; in the very centre is one round raised boss of white shell with a small red garnet on top. The rim of the disc is a band of plain gold with a row of tiny gold beads.
colours: Rich yellow gold, brown-gold in the shadows; many small flat red garnet panels, bright red with white glints; one small white shell boss in the centre.
pose: Seen from the front, face on, the round disc flat to the viewer as if hung in the air.
must_show: one round flat gold disc
many small red panels in gold cells covering its face
a white boss in the centre

what: a medieval coin pouch full of old gold coins: one small round pouch of dark scuffed chestnut leather, plump and heavy, sagging at the bottom, its neck gathered loosely with a leather thong and standing open at the top like a mouth; the open top is filled to overflowing with a heap of thick gold coins that bulge up out of the pouch above its rim, about ten coins showing, piled every way, overlapping, each with a raised rim; on the biggest coin, tilted toward the viewer at the front of the heap, is stamped the head of a Byzantine emperor in profile wearing a diadem.
colours: Dark scuffed chestnut-brown leather, darker in the folds; bright yellow gold coins, brown-gold in the shadows, white glints.
pose: Seen from the front and a little from above, the pouch upright, its open top and the heap of coins in it showing, as if hung in the air.
must_show: one round dark brown leather pouch, open at the top
a heap of many gold coins bulging out of its open top
an emperor's head stamped on a coin
must_not_show: loose coins apart from the heap

what: a heavy Celtic neck-ring of gold, a torc worn by a chieftain or a queen, lying flat and seen from directly above: one thick shining cable of twisted gold wires, as thick as a thumb, bent into a horseshoe shape like the letter U turned upside down, the round top of the U at the top of the picture and the two open ends at the bottom with a wide gap between them; each end finishes in a small solid gold knob no wider than two cables, carved with a swirl. The twist of the cable runs the whole way round in bold slanting ridges.
colours: Rich yellow gold, deep brown-gold in the grooves of the twist, white glints along the cable.
pose: Lying flat, seen from directly above, the horseshoe opening at the bottom, the two small knobs facing each other across the gap, the inside of the horseshoe empty backdrop.
must_show: one thick twisted gold cable bent into a horseshoe
a wide gap at the bottom
two small knobs at the ends

what: a necklace of natural pearls brought up by divers from the warm sea: one closed loop of about twenty large round pearls on a string, all the same size, each one touching the next, glossy and shining softly like the inside of a shell, creamy white with a faint rainbow sheen; at the top of the loop a small round clasp of yellow gold joins the two ends.
colours: Creamy white pearls with a soft silvery shine and faint pale rainbow sheen, pale grey shadows, white glints; one small yellow gold clasp.
pose: Seen from the front, hanging in the air as one closed loop, as if round an invisible neck, the clasp at the top, the inside of the loop empty backdrop.
must_show: one closed loop of large round white pearls
pearls all the same size, touching
small gold clasp

what: a heavy candelabra of solid silver from a great house: a tall stem standing on a broad round domed foot, and from the stem two curved arms sweep out to each side like a letter U, one inside the other, with a fifth candle-cup on top of the stem, five candle-cups in all at the same height; in each cup stands one tall white wax candle, unlit, with no flame. The silver is chased with leaves and is a little tarnished in the hollows.
colours: Bright silver, pale grey with white glints, charcoal and dark grey tarnish in the hollows; five white wax candles, unlit.
pose: Seen from the front, standing upright as if hung in the air, all five candles straight up, the whole candelabra inside the picture.
must_show: one tall silver candelabra on a round foot
five candle-cups with white candles
curved arms

what: an ancient Chinese jade bi, a disc laid in a tomb five thousand years ago: one large heavy thick flat disc of dull dark jade stone, a greyed deep green mottled with cloudy cream and rust-brown patches the way old buried jade goes, with one small perfectly round hole through its exact centre, the hole only a fifth as wide as the disc. Its faces are flat and plain, its edge thick and rounded, smoothly polished.
colours: Dull dark jade stone, a greyed deep green, cloudy cream and rust-brown mottled patches, a soft polished shine with a white glint on the edge.
pose: Seen from the front and a little to one side, the disc standing upright on its edge as if hung in the air, the thickness of its edge showing.
must_show: one large thick flat round disc of dark mottled green stone
one small round hole in its centre
thick rounded edge

what: a great woven tapestry from the looms of Arras, rolled up for carrying: one thick heavy roll of cloth like a rolled carpet, lying on a diagonal; the end of the roll at the lower left shows a spiral of rolled layers; round the roll, a hand's width from each end, is tied one thick dark brown rope wound three times and knotted, each rope plainly standing out against the cloth like a belt round a barrel; between the two ropes the outer face of the roll shows part of the woven picture: a white stag leaping among dark wine-coloured and deep blue flowers on a dark midnight-blue ground, with a gold thread border along its edge.
colours: Thick wool cloth: dark midnight-blue ground, dark wine-coloured and deep blue woven flowers, a white stag, a gold thread border, cream on the back of the cloth; dark brown cords.
pose: Lying on a diagonal, the spiral end at the lower left and the loose flap at the upper right, the whole roll inside the picture.
must_show: one thick rolled-up tapestry lying on a diagonal
a spiral of rolled layers at one end
a woven white stag on the outside of the roll
two thick dark ropes tied round the roll

what: a squat idol of a forgotten god cast in solid yellow gold: a small stiff block-like statue standing on a square gold base, with a huge square head as wide as its shoulders, a wide flat face with two big round staring eyes, a broad nose and a wide grimacing mouth showing a row of square teeth; on its head a tall crown of carved gold feathers standing up in a fan; its short stubby arms are folded across its round belly; it wears a carved gold kilt to its knees, and its short thick legs stand together on the base. It is heavy, crude and old.
colours: Rich deep yellow gold all over, deep brown-gold in the hollows and carved lines, bright white glints on the brow, cheeks, belly and feather tips.
pose: Seen from the front, standing upright on its square base as if hung in the air, facing the viewer.
must_show: one small squat gold statue on a square base
huge square head with big round eyes and bared square teeth
a crown of carved gold feathers
arms folded across its belly

what: a royal drinking horn of the ancient Persian kings, made of solid yellow gold: a tall fluted cup shaped like a horn, wide and open at its top rim and narrowing as it curves down, ending at the bottom in the front half of a winged lion, only its fierce roaring head, its chest, its two front legs held stiffly forward and two short wings swept up along the sides of the cup; the lion's body ends at its chest, where the cup grows out of it. Bands of fine ridges run round the cup like the grooves of a shell.
colours: Rich yellow gold all over, deep brown-gold in the grooves and hollows, white glints along the rim, on the lion's mane and wing feathers.
pose: Seen from the side, the open rim of the cup at the top, the lion's head and front legs at the bottom facing left, as if hung in the air, the whole horn inside the picture.
must_show: one gold drinking horn with an open rim at the top
the front half of a winged lion at the bottom
grooved bands round the cup
